from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,re,hashlib,subprocess,shutil
import pandas as pd,pdfplumber
b=Path('reports/research/510300_fund_quarterly_aggregate_exposure_joint_cases_v1')
protocol=json.loads((b/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
out=b/'三完整原组合跨页及官方目录日期证据.json'
assert not out.exists(),'完整原表已保存不重启'
poppler=shutil.which('pdftoppm')
assert poppler,'已发现Poppler但当前路径不可用'
records=[]
for source in protocol['fixed_local_original_sources']:
 case=source['case'];quarter=case['fixed_original_quarter'];pdf=Path(source['actual_original_pdf_path'])
 fact=Path(source['fact_receipt']);old=json.loads(fact.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
 annual=Path('data/raw/510300_original_fund_subscription_reports_v1/catalog_checkpoints')/(quarter[:4]+'.json')
 cat=json.loads(annual.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
 assert cat['status']=='PASS_COMPLETE_YEAR_CATALOG'
 matched=[]
 for page in cat['pages']:
  for row in page['response']['result']:
   if row.get('URL')==old['source']['relative_official_path']:
    matched.append({'raw_official_row':row,'request_url':page['request_url'],'request_params':page['request_params'],
      'retrieved_at':page['retrieved_at'],'response_sha256':page['response_sha256']})
 assert len(matched)==1,'原目录同href未唯一对应'
 row=matched[0]['raw_official_row']
 assert row['SECURITY_CODE']=='510300'
 assert row['SSEDATE']==old['source']['publication_date']
 assert row['SSEDATE']==old['identity']['reported_send_date']
 with pdfplumber.open(pdf) as doc:
  alltexts=[page.extract_text() or '' for page in doc.pages]
  starts=[i for i,t in enumerate(alltexts) if '5.1 报告期末基金资产组合情况' in t]
  assert len(starts)==1
  start=starts[0]; end=None
  for i in range(start,len(alltexts)):
   if re.search(r'5\.3\s',alltexts[i]):
    end=i;break
  assert end is not None,'原组合结束边界未知'
  pages=[]
  for i in range(start,end+1):
   page=doc.pages[i]
   prefix=b/f'{quarter}_完整原表第{i+1}页'
   command=[poppler,'-f',str(i+1),'-l',str(i+1),'-singlefile','-r','120','-png',str(pdf),str(prefix)]
   subprocess.run(command,check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
   pages.append({'PDF_page_number':i+1,'raw_page_text':alltexts[i],'raw_tables':page.extract_tables(),
      'render_path':str(prefix.with_suffix('.png')).replace('\\','/')})
  text='\n'.join(alltexts[start:end+1])
  section=text[text.index('5.1 报告期末基金资产组合情况'):]
  section=re.split(r'5\.3\s',section,maxsplit=1)[0]
  records.append({'case':case,'original_source':source,'source_clock':old['clock'],'cover_identity':old['identity'],
    'raw_catalog_path':str(annual).replace('\\','/'),'raw_catalog_sha256':hashlib.sha256(annual.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'actual_catalog_evidence':matched[0],'pages':pages,'complete_asset_industry_section':section,
    'original_table_scope_note':'2020Q3/2021Q2原表境内股票未拆指数/积极；2024Q1原表拆指数/积极。均保留原标签。',
    'historical_first_vintage_authenticated':False})
result={'extracted_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'records':records,
 'engineering_completion':'首提取依标题命中漏同一已存表的续页；本次只按同一原PDF的5.1至5.3边界补齐相邻完整页。首提取和原程序保留。无新增报告/钟/模型/参数/标签。',
 'source_clock_conclusion':'原SSE目录SSEDATE与报告送出日期匹配，沿原保守下一交易日可用；当前目录取得不认证真正首次版本。',
 'new_GETs':0,'new_financial_fits':0}
out.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
for r in records:
 print(json.dumps({'quarter':r['case']['fixed_original_quarter'],'official_publication_date':r['actual_catalog_evidence']['raw_official_row']['SSEDATE'],
 'full_section':r['complete_asset_industry_section'],'render_pages':[x['render_path'] for x in r['pages']]},ensure_ascii=False))
